notes: Ends at «أبي حية»: Ali's own words close the saying («ثم قال إنما أحببت أن أريكم»); «قال رأيت عليا» is Abu Hayya's first-person witness narration, so whether Ali is a last link (rule 6) or only the scene is for ruling (rule 11)
«قالا» and «ح» join the two branches at أبو الأحوص; the names written after the last «ح» form the shared tail
